text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a street corner. While out with Ryoka 
Tsurugi, we were waiting for the light to 
change, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after the traffic light turned green, 
she didn't move to cross. Her eyes were 
fixed intently on a single spot……

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
choice_data_list: Does that public screen catch your eye?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Oh, no! Sorry, the light...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the traffic light blinking behind us, 
we stepped aside so as not to block 
pedestrians. Then, seeing her apologetic 
look, I asked her about it.
choice_data_list: Was there any interesting show on?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me... I found myself quite 
captivated.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: —In the subtitles.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...To tell the truth, I've been 
studying. Ever since I got involved in 
video streaming activities.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
That show's subtitle pacing and color 
grading were so thoughtfully crafted, 
which is why...

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but I'll be fine! Shall we go, 
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I headed to a nearby cafe and secured a 
terrace seat with a clear view of the 
street monitor. Now, we should be able to 
watch the rest of the broadcast.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for being so thoughtful. Many of 
the programs shown on public street 
screens can only be seen right then and 
there, after all—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, that was a huge help. ...Could 
you please wait a moment?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, please, feel free to have a meal and 
make yourself at home.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nodding along, she promptly took out her 
smartphone to take notes as I watched over 
her quietly.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
...I see, matching it to the visual 
effects... ...and using that font for that 
kind of staging...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ryoka Tsurugi kept her enthusiastic gaze 
fixed on the screen until the program 
ended...

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for keeping you waiting. ...I 
hope you weren't too bored?
choice_data_list:
No, I was just admiring how earnest you 
are.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Fufu, that is rather ticklish to 
hear. It is really just a personal 
eccentricity of mine, however.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
...Our video streams are watched by people 
who are deaf or hard of hearing as well.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
I get a lot of fan letters too, saying how 
much they're encouraged by Elfie's 
boundless energy...

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
I want to deliver videos that are easy and 
fun to watch, even for people like them.
choice_data_list:
So that's why you're so particular about 
the subtitles……

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...All so that we can deliver 
entertainment to as many people as 
possible.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: That is my personal creed, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Contrary to her quiet tone, a blazing, 
crimson passion burned brightly within her 
eyes...

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
...On a personal note— I actually have two 
younger siblings who are quite a bit 
younger than me.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
My younger brother was frail... prone to 
illness. He was in and out of hospitals, 
and spent a lot of time feeling gloomy. 
But――

text_block_list.name: Ryoka's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text:
"Big Sis, Big Sis! Do that again! Show me 
one more time! That was so cool~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Entertainment brought a smile back to my 
little brother's face.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
That power, that brilliance... I witnessed 
it again... and again.
choice_data_list: I see…… Which is why you too――

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...I want to deliver it. To as many 
people as possible, to spread the spark of 
entertainment.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Because I feel... that's the only way to 
repay what brought a smile to my little 
brother's face back then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing Ryoka Tsurugi speak with such 
passion, I felt deeply moved. ...Is there 
anything more I can do to help someone who 
works this tirelessly?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. For instance, Tracen Academy is 
home to many different kinds of girls, 
but—
choice_data_list:
Would you like to hear more about video 
editing?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
! Could it be... you're willing to 
introduce a student to me...וג?!
choice_data_list:
There's this girl brimming with artistic 
flair...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, thanks in advance♪ It'll just be 
Curren's personal method, but if you're 
okay with that――

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to convey every single bit 
of it to you♡

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Yes, by all means...!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, thank you for this precious 
opportunity!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
And get this! This spot still feels kinda 
'meh,' so we add a color that goes *POW* 
right here, and then the movement goes 
*WHOOSH-BAM*!!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: I-I see...!
choice_data_list: A-Are you able to keep up?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it sounds like quite a high-level 
topic! Twin Turbo-san, if you wouldn't 
mind, please tell me more...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Sure thing!! Hehehe, leave it to Turbo!!
